rgb_mvtec_multiclass.description: Unimodal RGB multi-class anomaly detection and localization on MVTec-AD (15 categories, one model for all, normal-only training). Paper reference: AnomalDF with and without UCF under AnomalyDINO's full-shot protocol, Table XXIV (Exp. IDs 3-4: the whole category training set as the template bank; the UCF model trained with N=3 random templates is applied to the full bank without retraining). The gym runs the same dataset at 224x224 with a frozen DINOv2 ViT-S/14 and scores a hidden half of the official test set (880 images) whose defect types are disjoint from the visible development half; every metric is computed per category and averaged over the 15 categories, as in the paper.
rgb_mvtec_multiclass._scale_note: Scaled setup: 224px inputs (16x16 patch grid) instead of 256px, DINOv2 ViT-S/14, a compact 3D U-Net filter (about 4M parameters instead of +43.8M), and the hidden half of the MVTec-AD test set (880 of 1725 images). The paper's numbers come from its 256px setting on the whole test set; they are kept as the paper reported them and are not expected to be matched at this scale.

_paper_overhead.note: Table XII efficiency of AnomalDF+UCF. Self-reported cost numbers are not scored: the evaluator cannot recompute them from raw outputs.

rgb_mvtec_multiclass._paper_table_iv_metrics: The paper reports I-AUROC, I-AP, I-F1max, P-AUROC, P-AP, P-F1max and P-AUPRO for its RGB baselines (Table IV); AnomalDF+UCF itself is reported with I-/P-AUROC (Table I).

image_auroc.description: Image-level AUROC (%) of the per-image anomaly score: anomalous images ranked above normal ones.

pixel_auroc.description: Pixel-level AUROC (%) of the 224x224 anomaly maps over all pixels of the scored images.

pixel_aupro.description: Area under the per-region-overlap curve up to 30% pixel false-positive rate (%), normalised; every connected defect region counts equally, so small defects matter.

pixel_ap.description: Pixel-level average precision (%) of the anomaly maps; sensitive to false positives because defect pixels are rare.

image_ap.description: Image-level average precision (%) of the per-image anomaly score.

pixel_f1_max.description: Best pixel-level F1 (%) over all thresholds of the anomaly maps.

image_f1_max.description: Best image-level F1 (%) over all thresholds of the image score.

rgb_mvtec_multiclass._protocol: Class-wise mean: each metric is computed over one category's images and averaged over categories with equal weight (paper Tables I, III, IV, XXIV). A run whose class-mean image AUROC or pixel AUROC is below 70 in this experiment is scored as failed in it (0 on every metric); so is a missing or invalid outputs/<method>/predictions.npz.

_paper_table_xxiv.note: Table XXIV, MVTec-AD. Exp. IDs 1-2: resize 256, N=3 random templates (the same setting as Table I's AnomalDF columns); IDs 3-4: resize 256, full template bank (the gym's protocol, also in 'results'). AnomalDF's full-bank pixel AP is not reported ('-').

rgb_mvtec_multiclass._coefficient_note: Image and pixel AUROC carry the most weight because the paper's main tables report them; AUPRO, pixel AP and the F1 metrics are the paper's additional metrics, where it reports its largest gains (Sec. IV-A3, Fig. 8).

_paper_table_i.note: Table I (256px, N=3 random templates): image/pixel AUROC.

rgb_mvtec_multiclass._template_protocol: Full-shot (paper Table XXIV, AnomalyDINO's original setting): every training image of the input's category may serve as a template. The gym's baseline is that full memory bank (AnomalDF), so exhaustive template search is the comparison point, not a loophole. The UCF model is trained with N=3 random templates as in the paper; its cost volume keeps the 256 lowest costs per input token (the authors' code), so the same model takes the full-bank volume at test time.

rgb_visa_multiclass.description: Unimodal RGB multi-class anomaly detection and localization on VisA (12 categories of complex and multi-instance objects, one model for all, normal-only training, the official 1cls split). Paper reference: AnomalDF with and without UCF, Table XXIV Exp. IDs 11-12 (full template bank; the UCF model trained with N=3 random templates). The gym runs it at 224x224 with a frozen DINOv2 ViT-S/14 and scores a hidden two thirds of the official test set (1,428 images) whose defect types are disjoint from the visible development third; every metric is computed per category and averaged over the 12 categories.
rgb_visa_multiclass._scale_note: Scaled setup: 224px inputs (16x16 patch grid) instead of 256px, DINOv2 ViT-S/14, a compact 3D U-Net filter, and the hidden two thirds of the VisA test set. The paper's numbers come from its 256px setting on the whole test set; they are kept as reported and are not expected to be matched at this scale.
rgb_visa_multiclass._why: Added in the final hardening pass to enlarge the hidden test (MVTec-AD alone gives 880 hidden images, too few for image-level differences between good methods to clear the noise) with the paper's second RGB benchmark, where the paper reports its largest image-level gains for AnomalDF+UCF (Table III, +3.8 image AUROC at N=3).

pixel_auroc.description: Pixel-level AUROC (%) of the 224x224 anomaly maps over all pixels of the scored images.

image_ap.description: Image-level average precision (%) of the per-image anomaly score.

pixel_f1_max.description: Best pixel-level F1 (%) over all thresholds of the anomaly maps.

image_f1_max.description: Best image-level F1 (%) over all thresholds of the image score.

_paper_table_xxiv.note: Table XXIV, VisA. Exp. IDs 9-10: resize 256, N=3 random templates (Table III's AnomalDF columns: 90.5/97.5 -> 94.3/99.2 image/pixel AUROC); IDs 11-12: resize 256, full template bank (the gym's protocol, also in 'results'). AnomalDF's full-bank pixel AP is not reported ('-').
